description: Reproducible reconstruction and extension of a source-reported toy recommendation-evaluation example. The study evaluates fixed rank profiles under full-catalog and sampled candidate-set protocols, derives analytical metric expectations, performs a sample-size sensitivity sweep, uses AUC as a negative control, and validates analytical results with Monte Carlo checks.
